{{Quote|I recognize that configuration, Snips&mdash;they're building a ''laser cannon''!''"<br />"''But this satellite is in orbit over the ''Galactic Senate''! If they hit that, it would be a ''catastrophic'' blow to the Republic!|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Leisure" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sent a number of [[Agent/Legends|agents]] on a '''mission''' to infiltrate a [[Unidentified leisure satellite|leisure satellite]] that was visiting in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The mission==
{{Quote|Ventress has locked us onto a ''collision course'' with the Jedi Temple!|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Fashion" />}}
[[File:Mission_to_the_leisure_satellite_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] attacks [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]]]
At the [[leisure satellite]]'s [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] arena, a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] attempted to construct a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] with which to destroy the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the surface of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were present and prevented the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from succeeding.

At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] infiltrated the satellite and locked it on a collision course with the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Her efforts were thwarted thanks to intervention from [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]].
